attempts.sql: SELECT symbol_id, line_span AS line_count FROM code.symbol_profile WHERE NOT in_test_file AND NOT is_class ORDER BY line_span DESC, symbol_id ASC LIMIT 5

request:
What are the five longest functions or methods (classes excluded) in the non-test code, measured as the number of lines from the def line (decorators not counted) through the last line of the body? Return each symbol ID with its line count, longest first, ties broken by symbol ID alphabetically.

Requested output columns: symbol_id (string), line_count (integer). Order the rows as the question asks.
explanation: Filters code.symbol_profile to non-test functions and methods (excluding classes), then orders by line span descending with symbol_id as the tiebreaker and takes the top five.
sql: SELECT symbol_id, line_span AS line_count FROM code.symbol_profile WHERE NOT in_test_file AND NOT is_class ORDER BY line_span DESC, symbol_id ASC LIMIT 5
